accent: American English (only if supported by the existing selected voice)
speaker_change_policy: Never change voice_id or model_id between scenes or uploads without owner approval.
rendering_policy: Prefer one continuous narration render. If segmented, use exactly the same voice and settings for every segment.

speed_policy.note: These are performance targets, not instructions to switch speakers or radically alter pitch. Preserve intelligibility and natural rhythm.

emotion_policy: Direct the performance using supported provider controls or supported markup. If unavailable, use punctuation, sentence phrasing, pause placement and separate performance notes. Never send stage directions as spoken words.
loudness_policy: Use the existing audio pipeline's consistent output target; avoid clipping and aggressive compression.
approval_policy: Render a short voice sample and get owner approval before producing a long narration when the profile has changed.
